visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four individuals—two women and two men—are seated around a light-colored wooden table in a brightly lit restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows showing a modern city skyline. A woman in a white sweater and a person in a lime-green beanie are on the left, facing two men in grey and red jackets on the right; they are all gesturing animatedly with their hands and moving their mouths as if in deep conversation. (2) A server's hand places a wooden tray featuring four pieces of scallop sushi topped with sea urchin on the table; the four characters lean in with wide eyes and open mouths, some clapping their hands in anticipation. (3) The scene shifts to a full table covered in dozens of small plates, sushi platters, and sashimi bowls; the characters use chopsticks to pick up food while smiling and nodding. (4) A series of close-up shots showcases various dishes, including glistening salmon nigiri, a bowl of mixed seafood with salmon roe, and sea urchin sushi garnished with black caviar. (5) The man in the grey shirt holds a piece of shrimp sushi to his mouth and eats it with an exaggeratedly happy expression while the others watch; finally, the group raises glasses filled with amber liquid for a collective toast against the backdrop of the sunset city view.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One woman in a white off-the-shoulder knit top; one person in a lime green sweater and matching beanie; one man in a dark grey leather-style shirt; one man in a bright red denim jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A high-floor Japanese restaurant with warm wood accents, a large circular window offering a view of city high-rises including the Taipei 101 area, and modern indoor lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy group conversation featuring overlapping male and female voices with high pitch variability and rapid speech rates. BGM is an upbeat, high-tempo electronic dance track with a prominent synth bass. (2) A distinctive percussive 'thud' sound occurs as a wooden board hits a table. (3) A series of 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate visual transitions. (4) Dialogue sequence: A male voice asks a series of questions with rising intonation, followed by light laughter and playful choral encouragement from two female voices. (5) High-pitched cartoonish screaming and 'sparkle' SFX sound when food is eaten. (6) Transition to a professional male narrator with a clear, resonant tone and high arousal, describing ingredients with rhythmic emphasis. (7) Audio concludes with a group 'cheers' vocalization accompanied by the crisp clinking of glassware and a final energetic brand tagline.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Social Interaction -> Product Showcase -> Brand Call-to-Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Mao Jiang Sushi restaurant in Taipei by highlighting its premium ingredients (Hokkaido scallop, sea urchin), lively dining atmosphere, and high-floor city views during the holiday season.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand name, location details, menu labels, and promotional narrative from the creators.
